R. D. Blackmore, The Maid of Sker.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/r-d-blackmore/the-maid-of-sker

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- R. D. Blackmore, the author, died 1900 (Wikidata Q3316148; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/R._D._Blackmore).

First publication of the text used: 1872 (SE colophon: 'The Maid of Sker was published in 1872 by R. D. Blackmore.').

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1872, before 1931. Works published before 1931 are in the United States public domain.
- Country of origin: not needed. Every person named above died in 1925 or earlier, so the text is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever its country of first publication.
